content.text: OTC intravaginal options incl clotrimazole 1% cream 5 g daily for 7–14 days, miconazole 2% cream 5 g daily for 7 days, or miconazole 200 mg vaginal suppository for 3 days; Rx option: terconazole 0.4% cream 5 g daily for 7 days. Creams & suppositories oil based & might weaken latex condoms & diaphragms. Severe VVC: 7–14 days of topical azole (or fluconazole). Preg: only topical azoles, applied for 7 days, recommended. Topical agents USU cause ⍉systemic SE (local burning or irritate might occur)

⍉ use if a vaginal yeast infect was never dx'd by a doctor; ask a doctor first if on warfarin (bleed or bruising may occur); condoms & diaphragms may be damaged & fail to prevent preg or STDs; stop & see a doctor if Sx don't improve in 3 days or last > 7 days
